resources.string: See which security checks are enabled, advisory, conditional, or unavailable in this build.

No local match does not prove a file is safe. The signed hash engine stays disabled until a trusted signing key and a vetted production database are configured. YARA and machine learning are disabled. Heuristics can produce false alarms. Metrics below are not measured.
Import YARA rules for review (not executed)
Downloads only. Scan results, files, hashes, and package names are not uploaded.
Automatic updates are unavailable in this offline build or until a trusted signing key is configured.
